Method of Attack: Remote code execution via the WebexService Windows service that can be started and stopped by anyone and runs with System privileges, allowing execution of arbitrary commands remotely after authentication.
Privilege escalation by replacing the WebExService.exe executable due to Everyone group having full permissions.
Impacted Systems: Cisco WebEx online and video collaboration software
Attack Vector: Remote execution of Windows service commands using the sc command with authenticated access to the remote machine
Local privilege escalation by replacing the WebExService.exe executable
Indicators of Compromise: Use of sc command to start webexservice remotely (e.g., sc \\10.0.0.0 start webexservice a software-update 1 net localgroup administrators testuser /add)
Modification or replacement of WebExService.exe executable
Execution of commands like calc.exe or cmd.exe launched by WebexService with System privileges
